mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 85 degrees with light drizzle at Verona Community Park. If you are awake early, look for the ISS rising over Verona High School at 4:19 AM, traveling toward Fitchburg and reaching halfway up the sky. The temperature will drop to 73 degrees overnight with rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has installed the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park. This ash tree carving was donated by local artist Gerri Gurman and reflects traditional Tai Chi movements, with plans to add multilingual signage.
There is plenty to do with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market taking place today, plus trivia night at The Bogey Factory also happening today.
On August 30, Verona police responded to a report of a vehicle window being smashed on North Edge Trail, and an arrest warrant has been issued for the suspect.
Stop by for a scoop of today's flavor, Oreo Reese's Cheesecake, while the store is open until 10:00 PM.
